{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Inspect the first few rows and dtypes
print("Data types:")
print(data.dtypes)

print("\nFirst few rows of revenue:")
print(data['revenue'].head())

# Check for internal test orders (revenue == 999999.99)
internal_test_mask = data['revenue'] == '999999.99'
print(f"\nNumber of internal test orders: {internal_test_mask.sum()}")

# Convert revenue to float after removing commas
data['revenue_clean'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders and exclude internal test orders
completed_mask = data['status'] == 'completed'
valid_orders = data[completed_mask & ~internal_test_mask]

# Compute total revenue
total_revenue = valid_orders['revenue_clean'].sum()

# Print the result
total_revenue"}
